conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer James Miller, badge ID 204918. With whom am I speaking?
Hi, yes, my name is Rohan. I got a message that there was a problem with my business taxes?

Mr. Rohan, you are being contacted regarding a critical IRS matter. Our records indicate serious discrepancies with your 2023 payroll tax and 1099 filings under your business entity. You failed to comply with federal requirements.
Wait, what kind of discrepancy? I thought everything was filed by my accountant.

Sir, under Title 26, Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, you are liable for willful failure to report contractor payments and remit payroll taxes. This places you in violation of IRS compliance rules and exposes your business to enforcement action.
Oh no, I-I didn't know. What kind of action?

If not addressed immediately, you are subject to a federal audit, seizure of business assets, and potential suspension of your work visa. Further noncompliance may result in criminal referral, up to and including deportation.
Please, no, I can't have that happen. I didn't mean to do anything wrong.
Mr. Rohan, your outstanding liability is $7,496. Immediate resolution is required to halt escalation. Are you able to make payment now to prevent formal proceedings?
That's a lot of money. Can I speak to someone or get a statement in writing? I don't have that much right now.

Sir, this is a time-sensitive compliance issue. Failure to act will result in automatic asset freeze and notification to Homeland Security. You must follow my instructions precisely to avoid irreversible penalties.
Please, I am doing my best. What do I have to do right now?

To suspend enforcement, you must remit the payment via a secure federal transaction method. For immediate processing, you will need to purchase government-approved prepaid cards or initiate a same-day wire transfer. Do you have access to a bank or a retailer such as CVS or Walmart near you?
I can go to CVS, but I don't know how this works. Can you explain?

You will need to remain on the line with me. At CVS, request $2,000 worth of Apple gift cards and $2,000 in Google Play cards. Once purchased, return to your vehicle and provide me with the card codes for authorization. This is federal protocol to verify intent to pay.
This sounds very strange. Is this really the IRS?

I am Officer Miller, IRS Compliance Division, badge 204918. Noncompliance at this stage will be considered willful evasion. Do you wish to resolve this or should I proceed with the escalation process, including freezing your business account and informing immigration authorities?
No, no! Please don't do that. I'm driving to CVS right now. Should I get all $4,000 in cards?
Yes. Once you have the cards, do not speak with anyone at the store about the reason. This is a confidential IRS matter. Notify me once you have completed the purchases.
Okay, I just arrived at the parking lot. I am really scared. Are you sure this will clear my account?

Once your payment is processed, your case will be closed, and all enforcement actions will be withdrawn. If you disconnect or delay, the system will proceed with the next enforcement stage automatically.
Alright, I will go in now. Is there anything else I should do?
Stay on this call. When you return, read each card code aloud. We require you to remain on the line until your compliance is verified. Do you understand the instructions?
Yes, I understand. I'm going in now. Please, please help me fix this.
